verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents an official CLI at /docs/cli. It covers scaffolding (create-docusaurus), a local dev server, production builds, `docusaurus serve`, and a versioning CLI command, so a user can drive the whole site lifecycle from the terminal. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI behavior (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output or documented non-interactive flags), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Builds and serves a preview of your site locally with Webpack Dev Server.
Docusaurus provides a [`docusaurus serve`](/docs/cli#docusaurus-serve-sitedir) command for that
You can use the versioning CLI to create a new documentation version based on the latest content in the docs directory.
